app.name: JinDun Sentinel
app.tagline: Daily multi-country systemic financial risk monitoring, early warning and contagion analytics
spillover.notAvailable: This economy is measured by a published official stress index. It has no sub-market decomposition, so there is no cross-market spillover network to show.
spillover.unavailable: The cross-market spillover network could not be computed for this run.
spillover.note.method: method {method}; VAR order {order} (selected by {criterion}); horizon {horizon}; sample {start}–{end}
spillover.note.signed: the generalized decomposition is signed: negative entries mean the column node reduces the row node's forecast error variance
spillover.note.legacy: legacy appendix implementation: residual-correlation weighted index, not a forecast error variance decomposition
spillover.note.legacyHorizon: the legacy implementation is only defined when the horizon and the VAR order both equal the number of nodes, so it was computed with horizon {horizon}
spillover.note.unstable: WARNING: the fitted VAR is not stable; the decomposition is unreliable
spillover.note.crossCountry: the cross-country network is computed over the country composites on the percentile lens; only dates present in every country are used
spillover.note.needTwoCountries: at least two country runs are required for a cross-country network; found {count}
cycle.title: Global financial cycle
cycle.unavailable: The global cycle factor could not be produced from the BIS data.
cycle.countryPanel: Country panel first principal component — a different object, built from the monitored indices.
cycle.orientation: The sign of the factor is oriented on {anchor}, which correlates {correlation} with the factor: {meaning}
cycle.anchor.creditGapMean: the mean of the standardised credit gaps
cycle.anchor.inputMean: the mean of the standardised inputs
cycle.meaning.both: a higher factor means a {gap} credit-to-GDP gap and {growth} global credit growth
cycle.meaning.gap: a higher factor means a {gap} credit-to-GDP gap
cycle.meaning.growth: a higher factor means {growth} global credit growth
cycle.meaning.none: the sign follows the first principal component
cycle.note.variance: the first principal component explains {value} % of the variance of the BIS input block
cycle.note.lowVariance: the first principal component explains only {value} % of the variance of the BIS input block; the inputs do not move as one driver
cycle.note.panelLowVariance: the first principal component explains only {value} % of the common variance; the country stress indices are not dominated by a single global driver
cycle.note.weakInputs: these inputs are essentially orthogonal to the first component and carry it only weakly: {names}
cycle.note.notEstimated: the global cycle factor could not be estimated
cycle.note.noCompleteQuarter: the BIS input block has no complete quarter
cycle.note.needTwoCountries: at least two countries with a common calendar are required
cycle.note.noUsableDates: the country composites share no usable dates
cycle.note.carriedForward: the BIS factor is quarterly and is carried forward onto the daily calendar of the country panel; it does not move between publications
cycle.note.disabled: the global cycle factor is disabled in the configuration
cycle.note.inputsUnreadable: the BIS cycle inputs could not be read: {reason}
cycle.note.panelPublishedInstead: the country-panel factor is published instead; it is a different object
cycle.note.tooFewQuarters: only {have} common quarters were available; at least {need} are required to estimate a factor
cycle.note.noBisInput: no BIS input could be read
cycle.note.noCommonQuarter: the selected BIS series share no common quarter; the factor cannot be estimated
cycle.note.droppedQuarters: {count} quarter(s) were dropped because at least one input was missing
cycle.note.commonWindow: the common window is {start} to {end} ({count} quarters)
cycle.note.seriesNoRow: the {flow} series {name} matched no published row
cycle.note.seriesNoValue: the {flow} series {name} carries no usable value
run.warning.noMarketIndex: no market index could be built
run.warning.officialIndex: the country index is an official published stress index; this economy has no sub-market decomposition, so the market attribution and the cross-market spillover network are not available for it
run.warning.needsTwoMarkets: the cross-market spillover network needs at least two markets
run.warning.estimatorFailed: the {method} estimator could not be computed: {reason}
run.warning.noSurgeHistory: the rolling spill-out history could not be built; the surge alert stays silent for this run
run.warning.spilloverFailed: the spillover network could not be computed: {reason}
alert.composite_p1: no P1 alerts | one P1 alert above {threshold} | {count} P1 alerts above {threshold}
alert.composite_p2: no P2 alerts | one P2 alert above {threshold} | {count} P2 alerts above {threshold}
banking.note.snapshotMissing: the BIS bilateral snapshot is missing; run scripts/extract_bis_network.py to create it
